a: Poskin mezonot leeshet ish. ushemuel amar: en poskin mezonot leeshet ish. amar shemuel: mode li abba bishlosha chodashim harishonim, lefi sheen adam manniach beto rekan.
Besheshshamu bo shemmet kulle alma la peligi. ki peligi, beshello shamu bo shemmet. rav amar: poskin, deha meshuebad la. ushemuel amar: en poskin.
May tama? rav zevid amar: ema tzerare atpesa. rav pappa amar: chayyshinan shemma amar lah "tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich".
May benayyhu? ikka benayyhu gedola, vela safka.
I name ketanna vesafka.

Tenan: mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot, chanan amar: tishshava bassof, velo tishshava battechilla. nechleku alav bene kohanim gedolim veamru: tishshava battechilla uvassof. ad kan la peligi ella leinyan shevua, aval mezone yahavinan la! targema shemuel: besheshshamu bo shemmet.
Ta shema: mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot, bene kohanim gedolim omrim: tishshava, chanan omer: lo tishshava. veim ba veamar: pasakti lah mezonot — neeman!
Hacha name besheshshamu bo shemmet. veha "im ba veamar" kaamar! im ba leachar shemua.

Ta shema: mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot, veim ba veamar "tzei maase yadayich bimzonotayich" — rashshay. kadmu bet din ufasku — ma sheppasku pasku. hacha name besheshshamu bo shemmet.
Ta shema: mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veishto tovaat mezonot — bet din yordim linchasav vezanin umefarnesin leishto, aval lo banav uvenotav, velo davar acher!
Amar rav sheshet: bemashre et ishto al yede shalish. i hachi, banav uvenotav name! keshehishra lazo, velo hishra lazo. may paska?
Ella amar rav pappa: kesheshshama bo shemmet beed echad. hi, dei baaya innesove beed echad matzya minnasva — mezone name yahavinan la.
Banav uvenotav, dei bau lemechat linchasav beed echad la matzu nachati — mezone name la yahavinan lehu.
May "davar acher"? rav chisda amar: tachshit. rav yosef amar: tzedaka. man deamar tachshit, kol shekken
b: Tzedaka. man deamar tzedaka — aval tachshit yahavinan la, dela nicha leh detinnavvavl.
Ta shema: hayyevama — shelosha chodashim harishonim nizzonet mishshel balah,
Mikkan veelach, enah nizzonet lo mishshel balah velo mishshel yavam. amad baddin uvarach — nizzonet mishshel yavam.
Amar lecha shemuel: lemay nechush la lehay? i mishshum tzerare — la mikkarva dateh legabba, i mishshum maase yadeha — la mishtabeda leh.
Ta shema: haishsha shehalcha hi uvalah limdinat hayyam, uvat veamra "met bali", ratzta — nizzonet, ratzta — gova ketubbatah. "gershani baali" — mitparneset veholechet ad kede chetubbatah.
Hacha name kesheshshamu bo shemmet. umay shena ad kede chetubbatah? deihi hi deafseda annafsha.

Ta shema: ketzad amru memaenet en lah mezonot? i atta yachol lomar beyoshevet tachat balah — shehare balah chayyayv bimzonot. ella kegon shehalach balah limdinat hayyam, lavta veachla amda umeana. tama demeana, ha lo meana — yahavinan la!
Amar lach shemuel: hacha lemay nechush la? i mishshum tzerare — tzerare liktanna la matpes, vei mishshum maase yadeha — ketanna la safka.

May hava ala? ki ata rav dimi, amar: maase ba lifne rabbi bevet shearim ufasak lah mezonot. lifne rabbi yishmael betzippori, velo pasak lah mezonot. tahe ba rabbi yochanan: vechi ma raa rabbi yishmael shello pasak lah mezonot? ha lo nechleku bene kohanim gedolim vechanan ella leinyan shevua, aval mezone yahavinan la!
Amar leh rav shemen bar abba: kevar targema rabbenu shemuel bevavel kesheshshamu bo shemmet. amar leh: patritu bah kulle hay?

Ki ata ravin, amar: maase ba lifne rabbi bevet shearim, velo pasak lah mezonot. lifne rabbi yishmael betzippori, ufasak lah mezonot. amar rabbi yochanan: ma raa rabbi shello pasak lah? deha lo nechleku chanan uvene kohanim gedolim ella leinyan shevua, aval mezonot yahavinan la. amar leh rav shemen bar abba: kevar targema shemuel bevavel kesheshshamu bo shemmet. amar leh: patritu bah kulle hay?
Vehilcheta kevateh derav, ufoskin mezonot leeshet ish. vehilcheta kevateh derav huna amar rav. deamar rav huna amar rav: yechola ishsha shettomar levalah "eni nizzonet veeni osa".
Vehilcheta kevateh derav zevid bekuneya. deamar rav zevid: hane mane dekuneya — chivvare veukkame sheru.
Yerukke asiri. vela amaran ella delet behu kartufane, aval it behu kartufane — asiri.
Mishna mi shehalach limdinat hayyam, veamad echad ufirnes et ishto, chanan omer: ibbed et meotav.

Nechleku alav bene kohanim gedolim veamru: yishshava kamma hotzi veyittol. amar rabbi dosa ben harekinas kedivrehem. amar rabbi yochanan ben zakkay: yafe amar chanan, hinniach meotav al keren hatztzevi.
Gemara tenan hatam: hammuddar hanaa mechavero —

a: Shokel lo et shiklo, uforea et chovo, umachazir lo avedato. uvemakom shennotlin sachar — tippol hanaa lahekdesh.
Bishlama shokel lo et shiklo — mitzva kaaved. ditnan: tormin al haavud veal haggavuy veal heatid liggavot.
Umachazir lo avedato name mitzva kaaved. ella porea lo et chovo, ha kamishtarshi leh!
Amar rav oshaya: ha manni? chanan hi, deamar: ibbed et meotav.
Verava amar: afillu tema rabbanan, hacha bemay askinan, shellava al menat shello lifroa.
Bishlama rava la amar kerav oshaya: demokem la kerabbanan. ella rav oshaya, may tama la amar kerava? amar lach rav oshaya: nehi dahanaa let leh,
b: Kissufa mi let leh? hatam name it leh hanaa behahi hanaa demikkesif minneh.

Mishna admon omer, shiva: mi shemmet vehinniach banim uvanot, bizman shehannechasim merubbin — habbanim yorshim, vehabbanot nizzonot. uvinchasim muatim — habbanot yizzonu, vehabbanim — yechazzeru al happetachim. admon omer: bishvil sheani zachar hifsadti?! amar rabban gamliel: roe ani et divre admon.
Gemara may kaamar? amar abbaye, hachi kaamar: bishvil sheani zachar verauy laasok battora — hifsadti?
Amar leh rava: man deasek battora hu deyaret, man dela asek battora la yaret?! ella amar rava, hachi kaamar: bishvil sheani zachar verauy lirash binchasim merubbin — hifsadti binchasim muatin?!

Mishna hattoen et chavero kadde shemen vehoda bakkankannim, admon omer: hoil vehoda bemiktzat hatteana — yishshava. vachachamim omrim: en hodaat miktzat mimmin hattaana. amar rabban gamliel: roe ani et divre admon.
Gemara shema minna lerabbanan: teano chittin useorin vehoda bisorin — patur.
Lema tihve teyuveta derav nachman amar shemuel, deamar rav nachman amar shemuel: teano chittin useorim vehoda lo beechad mehen — chayyayv!
Amar rav yehuda amar rav: betoano midda. i hachi, may tama deadmon?

Ella amar rava: dechulle alma hecha daamar leh "melo asara kadde shemen yesh li bevorecha", shemen kataen leh, kankannim la kataen leh. "asara kadde shemen meleim yesh li etzlecha" — shemen vekankannim kataen leh.
Ki peligi hecha daamar leh "asara kadde shemen yesh li etzlecha". admon omer: yesh ballashon hazze leshon kankannim, verabbanan savri: en ballashon hazze leshon kankannim.

Ella tama deen ballashon hazze leshon kankannim, ha yesh ballashon hazze leshon kankannim — chayyayv. lema tehve teyuveta derabbi chiyyay bar abba. deamar rabbi chiyyay bar abba: teano chittin useorim vehoda lo beechad mehem — patur!
Amar rav shimi bar ashe: naasa kemi shetteano rimmon biklippato. matkef la ravina: rimmon belo kelippato la minnetar, shemen minnetar belo kankannim!
Ella, hacha bemay askinan, daamar leh: asara kadde shemen yesh li etzlecha, vaamar leh iddach: shemen — lo hayu devarim meolam, kankannim name — chamsha it lach, vechamsha let lach.

Admon omer: yesh ballashon hazze leshon kankannim, umiggo dekamishteva akkankannim mishteva name ashshemen al yede gilgul. verabbanan savri: en ballashon hazze leshon kankannim. ma shetteano lo hoda lo, uma shehoda lo — lo taanu.
Mishna happosek maot lachatano, ufashat lo et haregel —

a: Teshev ad sheyyalbin roshah. admon omer: yechola hi shettomar: illu ani pasakti leatzmi — eshev ad sheyyalbin roshi, achshav sheabba pasak — ma ani yechola laasot? o kenos, o petor. amar rabban gamliel: roe ani et divre admon.

Gemara matnitin dela ki hay tanna, detanya: amar rabbi yose berabbi yehuda: lo nechleku admon vachachamim al happosek maot lachatano ufashat lo et haregel, sheyyechola hi shettomar: "abba pasak alay, ma ani yechola laasot".

Al ma nechleku — al sheppaska hi al atzmah. shechachamim omrim: teshev ad shettalbin roshah. admon omer, yechola hi shettomar: kisvura ani sheabba noten alay, veachshav sheen abba noten alay — ma ani yechola laasot? o kenos o petor. amar rabban gamliel: roe ani et divre admon.
Tana: bamme devarim amurim bigdola, aval biktanna — kofin. kofin leman? ilema leav — ippecha mibbee leh! ella amar rava: kofin labbaal litten get.

Amar rabbi yitzchak ben elazar mishshemeh dechizkiyya: kol makom sheamar rabban gamliel "roe ani et divre admon" — halacha kemoto. amar leh rava lerav nachman: afillu bevarayyta? amar leh: mi kaamrinan bammishna?! bechol makom sheamar rabban gamliel kaamrinan.
Amar rabbi zera amar rabba bar yirmeya: shene devarim sheamar chanan — halacha kayyotze bo, shiva devarim sheamar admon — en halacha kayyotze bo. may kaamar?

Illema hachi kaamar: shene devarim sheamar chanan — halacha kemoto vechayyotze bo, veshiva devarim sheamar admon — en halacha kemoto velo kayyotze bo. vehaamar rabbi yitzchak ben elazar mishshemeh dechizkiyya: kol makom sheamar rabban gamliel "roe ani et divre admon" — halacha kemoto!
Ella hachi kaamar: shene devarim sheamar chanan — halacha kemoto vechayyotze bo, shiva devarim sheamar admon — en halacha kayyotze bo. ha kemoto — halacha bechullehu.
Vehaamar rabbi yitzchak ben elazar mishshemeh dechizkiyya: kol makom sheamar rabban gamliel "roe ani et divre admon" — halacha kemoto, amar — in, lo amar — la!

Ella hachi kaamar: shene devarim sheamar chanan — halacha kemoto vechayyotze bo, shiva devarim sheamar admon — yesh mehen shehalacha kemoto vechayyotze bo, veyesh mehen sheen halacha kemoto ella kayyotze bo.
Bechol makom sheamar rabban gamliel roe ani et divre admon — halacha kemoto, inach — la.
Mishna haorer al hassade, vehu chatum aleha beed — admon omer: hashsheni noach li, veharishon kashe hemennu.
Vachachamim omrim: ibbed et zechuto. asaah siman leacher — ibbed et zechuto.
Gemara amar abbaye: lo shanu ella ed, aval dayyayn — lo ibbed et zechuto. detane rabbi chiyyay: en haedim chotmin al hashshetar ella im ken kerauhu.
b: Aval haddayyaynin chotmim af al pi shello kerauhu.
Asaah siman leacher. amar abbaye: lo shanu ella leacher, aval leatzmo — lo ibbed et zechuto.
Deamar: i dela avadi leh hachi la hava mezabben la nihali, may it lach lememar? ibbei li lemimsar modaa — chavrach chavra it leh, vechavra dechavrach chavra it leh.
Hahu daasaah siman leacher, arar, ushechev, veokem appotroppa. ata appotroppos lekammeh deabbaye. amar leh: asaah siman leacher ibbed et zechuto.

Amar: i hava avuhon deyatme kayyaym, hava taen veamar: "telem echad asiti lach". amar leh: shappir kaamrat. deamar rabbi yochanan, im taan veamar "telem echad asiti lach" — neeman. zil hav leh mihat telem echad.

Hava ala richba dedikle, amar leh: i hava avuhon deyatme kayyaym, hava taen veamar, chazarti velakachti mimmennu. amar leh: shappir kaamrat. deamar rabbi yochanan: im taan veamar "chazarti ulekachtiv mimmennu" — neeman. amar abbaye: hay man demokem appotroppa — nokem ki hay deyada leappoche bizchuta deyatme.
Mishna mi shehalach limdinat hayyam veavda derech sadehu. admon omer: yelech lo biktzara. vachachamim omrim: yikne lo derech bemea mane, o yifrach baavir.
Gemara may tama derabbanan, shappir kaamar admon! amar rav yehuda amar rav: kegon shehikkifuha arbaa bene adam mearba ruchoteha — i hachi, may tama deadmon?
Amar rava: bearbea deatu mikkoach arbea, vearbea deatu mikkoach chad — kulle alma la peligi dematze medache leh. ki peligi bechad deate mikkoach arbea.
Admon savar: mikkol makom darka it li gabbach. verabbanan savri: i shatkat — shatkat, vei la — mahdarna shetara lemarayyhu vela matzet leishtaoye dina bahadayyhu.
Hahu daamar lehu: dikla livrat. azul yatme pelug lenichse, la yehavu la dikla. sevar rav yosef lememar: hayeynu matnitin.
Amar leh abbaye: mi dame? hatam kol chad vechad matze medache leh, hacha dikla gabbayyhu hu. may takkantayyhu? littevu la dikla velehderu velippalgu meresha.
Hahu daamar lehu: dikla livrat. shechev ushevayk tere palge dedikla.
Yatev rav ashe veka kashya leh: mi karu inashe litre palge dikle dikla, o la? amar leh rav mardochay lerav ashe: hachi amar avimi mehageronya mishshemeh derava: karu inashe litre palge dikle dikla.

a: Mishna hammotzi shetar chov al chavero, vehalla hotzi shemmachar lo et hassade. admon omer: yachol hu sheyyomar: illu hayiti chayyayv lecha — haya lecha lehippara et shellecha keshemmacharta li et hassade. vachachamim omrim: ze haya pikkeach, shemmachar lo et hakkarka mippene shehu yachol lemashkeno.
Gemara may tama derabbanan? shappir kaamar admon! beatra deyahavi zuze vahadar katvi shetara — kulle alma la peligi dematze amar leh: haya lecha lifroa et shellecha keshemmacharta li et hassade.
Ki peligi, beatra dechatvi shetara vahadar yahavi zuze. admon savar: ibbei leh lemimsar modaa. verabbanan savri: chavrach chavra it leh vechavra dechavrach chavra it leh.
Mishna shenayim shehotziu shetar chov ze al ze, admon omer: illu hayiti chayyayv lecha — ketzad atta love mimmenni?! vachachamim omrim: ze gove shetar chovo, veze gove shetar chovo.
Gemara ittemar: shenayim shehotziu shetar chov ze al ze. rav nachman amar: ze gove veze gove. rav sheshet amar: happoche matrata lamma li. ella ze omed beshello veze omed beshello.
Dechulle alma iddit veiddit, benonit uvenonit, zibburit vezibburit — vadday happoche matrata hu.
Ki peligi, deit leh lechad benonit ulechad zibburit — rav nachman savar: ze gove veze gove. kasavar: beshello hen shamin.
Ate baal zibburit vegave leh levenonit, dahava gabbeh iddit, vaata hahu veshakel zibburit.
Verav sheshet amar: happoche matrata lamma li, kasavar: beshel kol adam hen shamin, sof sof ki ate hahu — benonit denafsheh kashakel.
Ulerav nachman: may chazet deate baal zibburit beresha, lete baal benonit beresha veligbe zibburit, velehdar veligbe nihaleh!
La tzericha, dikdem taveh. sof sof ki ato lemigbe, bahade hadade kaatu!
Ella, la tzericha deit leh lechad iddit uvenonit, veit leh lechad zibburit — mar savar: beshello hen shamin, umar savar: beshel kol adam hen shamin.
Tenan, vachachamim omrim: ze gove veze gove! targema rav nachman allibba derav sheshet: kegon shellava ze leeser veze lechamesh.
Hechi dame? illema rishon leeser vesheni lechamesh, beha lema admon: illu hayiti chayyayv lecha ketzad atta love mimmenni? ha la meta zimneh. ella rishon lechamesh, vesheni leeser.
Hechi dame? i dimta zimneh — may tama derabbanan. vei dela meta zimneh — ha la meta zimneh, umay tama deadmon?
La tzericha daata behahu yoma demishlam chamesh. mar savar: avid inish deyazef leyomeh, umar savar: la avid inish deyazef leyomeh.
Rame bar chama amar: hacha beyatme askinan, deyatme migba gavuy, agboye la magbinan minnayyhu. veha "ze gove veze gove" katane! ze gove, veze rauy ligbot veen lo.

Amar rava: shete teshuvot baddavar, chada: deze gove veze gove katane. veod, lagbinhu ara leyatme velehdar veligbinhu minnayyhu, kidrav nachman. deamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: yetomim sheggavu karka bechovat avihen — baal chov chozer vegove otah mehen. kashya.

Velokma deit lehu leyatme zibburit, veit leh ledideh iddit uvenonit, deazli yatme gavu benonit, umagbu leh zibburit. dei name beshel kol adam hen shamin, ha en nifrain minnichse yetomim ella mizzibburit!
Hane mille hecha dela tefas, aval hecha ditfas — tefas.
Mishna shalosh aratzot lenissuin: yehuda veever hayyarden vehaggalil — en motziin meir lair umikkerach lichrach. aval beotah haaretz — motziin meir leir umikkerach lichrach.
b: Aval lo meir lichrach, velo mikkerach leir.
Motziin minnave hara(5) lenave hayyafe, aval lo minnave hayyafe lenave hara(5). rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: af lo minnave ra(5) lenave yafe, mippene shehannave hayyafe bodek.
Gemara bishlama mikkerach lair — devichrach shechichi kol mille, beir la shechichi kol mille. ella meir lichrach may tama?
Mesayyay leh lerabbi yose bar chanina. deamar rabbi yose bar chanina: minnayin sheyyeshivat kerakkim kasha, shenneemar: "vayvarchu haam lechol haanashim hammitnaddevim lashevet birushalaym".

Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer kulei. may "bodek"? kedishmuel. deamar shemuel: shinnuy veset techillat choli meayim. katuv besefer ben sira: "kol yeme ani raim". vehaikka shabbatot veyamim tovim? kedishmuel. deamar shemuel: shinnuy veset techillat choli meayim.
Ben sira omer: "af lelot, bishfal gaggim gaggo, uvimrom harim karmo, mimmetar gaggim legaggo, umeafar karmo lichramim".
Mishna hakkol maalin leeretz yisrael, veen hakkol motziin. hakkol maalin lirushalayim, veen hakkol motziin. echad haanashim veechad hannashim.

Nasa ishsha beeretz yisrael vegershah beeretz yisrael — noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael. nasa ishsha beeretz yisrael vegershah bekappotkeya — noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael. nasa ishsha bekappotkeya vegershah beeretz yisrael — noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: noten lah mimmeot kappotkeya. nasa ishsha bekappotkeya vegershah bekappotkeya — noten lah mimmeot kappotkeya.
Gemara "hakkol maalin" leetoye may? leetoye avadim.
Uleman detane avadim behedya, leetoye may? leetoye minnave hayyafe lenave hara(5).
"Veen hakkol motziin" leetoye may? leetoye eved shebbarach mechutza laaretz laaretz, deamrinan leh: zabbeneh hacha vezil, mishshum yeshivat eretz yisrael.
"Hakkol maalin lirushalayim" leetoye may? leetoye minnave hayyafe lenave hara(5).
"Veen hakkol motziin" leetoye may? leetoye afillu minnave hara(5) lenave hayyafe. veayyeyde ditna resha "en motziin", tena sefa name "en motziin".

Tanu rabbanan: hu omer laalot, vehi omeret shello laalot — kofin otah laalot, veim lav — tetze belo ketubba. hi omeret laalot, vehu omer shello laalot — kofin oto laalot, veim lav — yotzi veyitten ketubba.

Hi omeret latzet, vehu omer shello latzet — kofin otah shello latzet, veim lav — tetze belo ketubba. hu omer latzet, vehi omeret shello latzet — kofin oto shello latzet, veim lav — yotzi veyitten ketubba.
Nasa ishsha kulei. ha gufa kashya:

Katane: nasa ishsha beeretz yisrael vegershah bekappotkeya, noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael — alma batar shibuda azlinan. ema sefa: nasa ishsha bekappotkeya vegershah beeretz yisrael, noten lah mimmeot eretz yisrael — alma batar guveyayna azlinan!
Amar rabba: mikkulle chetubba shanu kan. kasavar ketubba derabbanan.
Rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: noten lah mimmeot kappotkeya. kasavar ketubba deorayyta.

Tanu rabbanan: hammotzi shetar chov al chavero, katuv bo bavel — magbehu mimmeot bavel, katuv bo eretz yisrael — magbehu mimmeot eretz yisrael. katuv bo setam, hotzio bevavel — magbehu mimmeot bavel, hotzio beeretz yisrael — magbehu mimmeot eretz yisrael. katuv bo kesef setam — ma sheyyirtze love magbehu. ma sheen ken bichtubba.
Aheyay? amar rav mesharsheya: aresha, leappoke midderabban shimon ben gamliel, deamar ketubba deorayyta.
Katuv bo kesef setam — ma sheyyirtze love magbehu. veema nesacha? amar rabbi elazar: dichtiv beh matbea. veema perite? amar rav pappa: perite dechaspa la avdi inashe.

Tanu rabbanan: leolam yadur adam beeretz yisrael afillu beir sherubbah goyim, veal yadur bechutza laaretz vaafillu beir sherubbah yisrael, shekkol haddar beeretz yisrael dome kemi sheyyesh lo eloah, vechol haddar bechutza laaretz dome kemi sheen lo eloah. shenneemar: "latet lachem et eretz kenaan lihyot lachem lelohim".

Vechol sheeno dar baaretz en lo eloah? ella lomar lach: kol haddar bechutza laaretz keillu oved avoda zara. vechen bedavid hu omer: "ki gershuni hayyom mehistappeach benachalat Adonai lemor lech avod elohim acherim", vechi mi amar lo ledavid lech avod elohim acherim? ella lomar lach: kol haddar bechutza laaretz — keillu oved avoda zara.
Rabbi zera hava kamishtemit minneh derav yehuda diva lemissak leeretz yisrael, deamar rav yehuda: kol haole mibbavel leeretz yisrael over baase, shenneemar:

a: "Bavela yuvau veshamma yihyu ad yom pokdi otam neum Adonai". verabbi zera — hahu bichle sharet ketiv.
Verav yehuda? ketiv kera acharina: "hishbati etchem benot yerushalaym bitzvaot o beaylot hassade vegomer".
Verabbi zera — hahu shello yaalu yisrael bechoma. verav yehuda? "hishbati" acharina ketiv.

Verabbi zera — hahu mibbee leh lechidrabbi yose berabbi chanina, deamar: shalosh shevuot hallalu lamma? achat shello yaalu yisrael bechoma, veachat shehishbia hakkadosh baruch hu et yisrael shello yimredu beummot haolam, veachat shehishbia hakkadosh baruch hu et haggoyim shello yishtabedu bahen beyisrael yoter midday.
Verav yehuda — "im tairu veim teorru" ketiv.

Verabbi zera — mibbee leh lechidrabbi levi, deamar: shesh shevuot hallalu lamma? telata — hane daamaran, inach: shello yegallu et hakketz, veshello yerachaku et hakketz, veshello yegallu hassod laggoyim.
"Bitzvaot o beaylot hassade", amar rabbi elazar: amar lahem hakkadosh baruch hu leyisrael, im attem mekayyeymin et hashshevua — mutav, veim lav — ani mattir et besarchem kitzvaot ucheaylot hassade.
Amar rabbi elazar: kol haddar beeretz yisrael sharuy belo avon, shenneemar: "uval yomar shachen chaliti haam hayyoshev bah nesu avon". amar leh rava lerav ashe: anan besovle cholaim matnenan la.
Amar rav anan: kol hakkavur beeretz yisrael keillu kavur tachat hammizbeach. ketiv hacha: "mizbach adama taase li", uchetiv hatam: "vechipper admato ammo".

Ulla hava regil dahava salek leeretz yisrael, nach nafsheh bechutz laaretz. ato amaru leh lerabbi elazar. amar: ant ulla, "al adama temea tamut". amru lo: arono ba. amar lahem: eno dome kolatto mechayyim lekolatto leachar mita.
Hahu gavra dinfala leh yevama be chozaa, ata lekammeh derabbi chanina, amar leh: mahu lemechat uleyabboma?
Amar leh: achiv nasa kutit vamet — baruch hammakom sheharago. vehu yered acharav?!

Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: keshem sheasur latzet meeretz yisrael levavel kach asur latzet mibbavel lishar aratzot. rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: afillu mippumebdita leve chubbe. hahu dinfak mippumebdita leve chubbe, shamteh rav yosef. hahu dinfak mippumebdita leastonya, shechev. amar abbaye: i bae hay tzureba merabbanan, hava chaye.

Rabba verav yosef deamri tarvayyhu: kesherin shebbevavel eretz yisrael kolattan, kesherin shebbishar aratzot bavel kolattan. lemay? ilema leyuchasin, vehaamar mar: kol haaratzot issa leeretz yisrael, veeretz yisrael issa levavel! ella leinyan kevura.

Amar rav yehuda: kol haddar bevavel keillu dar beeretz yisrael, shenneemar: "hoy tziyyon himmalti yoshevet bat bavel". amar abbaye, naktinan: bavel la chazya chavle demashiach. targema ahutzal devinyamin, vekaru leh karna deshezavta.
Amar rabbi elazar: metim shebbechutz laaretz enam chayyim, shenneemar: "venatatti tzevi beeretz chayyim" — eretz shetztzivyoni bah meteha chayyim, sheen tzivyoni bah — en meteha chayyim.

Metiv rabbi abba bar memel: "yichyu metecha nevelati yekumun", may lav: "yichyu metecha" — metim shebbeeretz yisrael. "nevelati yekumun" — metim shebbechutz laaretz. umay "venatatti tzevi beeretz chayyim" — annevuchad netztzar hu dichtiv, deamar rachamana: mayytena alayyhu malka dekallil ki tavya.
Amar leh: rabbi, mikra acher ani doresh: "noten neshama laam aleha veruach laholchim bah". veella hachtiv "nevelati yekumun"! hahu binfalim hu dichtiv.

Verabbi abba bar memel, hay "noten neshama laam aleha" may aved leh? mibbee leh lechidrabbi avahu. deamar rabbi avahu: afillu shifcha kenaanit shebbeeretz yisrael muvetach lah shehi bat haolam habba. ketiv hacha: "laam aleha", uchetiv hatam: "shevu lachem po im hachamor" — am haddome lachamor.
"Veruach laholchim bah", amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hamehallech arba ammot beeretz yisrael muvetach lo shehu ben haolam habba.

Ulerabbi elazar, tzaddikim shebbechutz laaretz enam chayyim?! amar rabbi ila: al yede gilgul. matkef la rabbi abba salla rabba: gilgul letzaddikim tzaar hu! amar abbaye: mechillot naasot lahem bakkarka.

"Unesatani mimmitzrayim ukevartani bikvuratam", amar karna, devarim bego: yodea haya yaakov avinu shetztzaddik gamur haya, veim metim shebbechutza laaretz chayyim, lama hitriach et banav? shemma lo yizke limchillot.

Kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "vayyashba yosef et bene yisrael vegomer", amar rabbi chanina, devarim bego: yodea haya yosef beatzmo shetztzaddik gamur haya, veim metim shebbachutza laaretz chayyim, lama hitriach et echav arba meot parsa? shemma lo yizke limchillot.

Shelachu leh achohi lerabba: yodea haya yaakov shetztzaddik gamur haya vechulei. ilfa mosif bah devarim: maase beechad shehaya mitztaer al ishsha achat, uvikkesh lered, kevan sheshshama kazot, gilgel beatzmo ad yom moto.
Af al pi shechacham gadol atta, eno dome lomed meatzmo lallomed merabbo. veim tomar en lecha rav — yesh lecha rav, umannu — rabbi yochanan.

Veim en atta ole — hizzaher bishlosha devarim: al tarbe bishiva — sheyyeshiva kasha letachtoniyyot, veal tarbe baamida — sheamida kasha lallev, veal tarbe bahalicha — shehalicha kasha laenayim. ella shelish bishiva, shelish baamida, shelish behilluch.
Kol yeshiva sheen immah semicha — amida nocha hemenna. amida salka datach? vehaamrat amida kasha lallev! ella: yeshiva
b: Sheen bah semicha — amida sheyyesh bah semicha nocha hemenna.
Vechen amru: yitzchak veshimon veoshaya amru davar echad: halacha kerabbi yehuda bifradot. detanya rabbi yehuda omer: pirda shettava — en marbiin aleha lo sus velo chamor, ella minah.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: yitzchak — ze rabbi yitzchak nappacha, shimon — ze rabbi shimon ben pazzi, veamri la: resh lakish, oshaya — ze rabbi oshaya berabbi.

Amar rabbi elazar: amme haaratzot enan chayyim, shenneemar: "metim bal yichyu vegomer", tanya name hachi: "metim bal yichyu", yachol lakkol — talmud lomar: "refaim bal yakumu", bimrappe atzmo middivre tora hakkatuv medabber.

Amar leh rabbi yochanan: la nicha lemarayyhu deamrat lehu hachi, hahu bimrappe atzmo laavoda zara hu dichtiv. amar leh: mikra acher ani doresh, dichtiv: "ki tal orot tallecha vaaretz refaim tappil", kol hammishtammesh beor tora — or tora mechayyehu, vechol sheen mishtammesh beor tora — en or tora mechayyehu.

Kevan dechazyeh dekamitztaar, amar leh: rabbi, matzati lahen takkana min hattora: "veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom", vechi efshar liddabboke bashshechina? vehachtiv: "ki Adonai elohecha esh ochla"?
Ella: kol hammassi bitto letalmid chacham, vehaose perakmatya letalmide chachamim, vehamehanne talmide chachamim minnechasav — maale alav hakkatuv keillu middabbek bashshechina.

Kayyotze baddavar atta omer: "leahava et Adonai elohecha uledovka vo", vechi efshar laadam liddabbek bashshechina? ella: kol hammassi bitto letalmid chacham, vehaose perakmatya letalmide chachamim, vehamehanne talmide chachamim minnechasav — maale alav hakkatuv keillu middabbek bashshechina.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar yosef: atidin tzaddikim shemmevatzbetzin veolin birushalayim, shenneemar: "veyatzitzu meir keesev haaretz", veen "ir" ella yerushalayim, shenneemar: "vegannoti el hair hazzot".

Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar yosef: atidim tzaddikim sheyyaamdu bemalbushehen, kal vachomer mechitta: ma chitta shennikbera arumma — yotza bechamma levushin, tzaddikim shennikberu bilvushehen — al achat kamma vechamma.
Veamar rabbi chiyyay bar yosef: atida eretz yisrael shettotzi gelusekaot uchele melat, shenneemar: "yehi fissat bar baaretz".

Tanu rabbanan: "yehi fissat bar baaretz berosh harim", amru: atida chitta shettittammer kedekel, veola berosh harim. veshemma tomar: yesh tzaar lekotzrah! talmud lomar: "yirash kallevanon piryo" — hakkadosh baruch hu mevi ruach mibbet genazav umenashshevah aleha umashshira et soltah, veadam yotze lassade umevi melo pissat yado, umimmenna parnasato ufarnasat anshe veto.
"Im chelev kilyot chitta", amru: atida chitta shettehe kishte chelayot shel shor haggadol. veal titma, shehare shual kinnen belefet, ushekaluhu, umatzu bo shishshim litrin, belitra shel tzippori.

Tanya, amar rav yose: maase beshichin beechad shehinniach lo aviv shelosha badde chardal venifshach echad mehen venimtzeu bo tisha kabbin chardal. veetzav, sikkechu bo sukkat yotzrin. amar rabbi shimon ben tachlifa: kelach shel keruv hinniach lanu abba, vehayinu olim veyordim bo besullam.

"Vedam enav tishte chamer", amru: lo kaolam hazze haolam habba. haolam hazze yesh bo tzaar livtzor velidroch, haolam habba mevi anava achat bakkaron o bisfina, umannichah bezavit beto, umesappek hemenna kefitos gadol. veetzav, massikin tachat hattavshil. veen lecha kol anava vaanava sheen bah sheloshim garve yayin, shenneemar: "vedam enav tishte chamer", al tikre "chamer" ella "chomer".

Ki ata rav dimi, amar: may dichtiv "osri laggefen iro" — en lecha kol gefen vagefen shebbeeretz yisrael sheen tzarich ayir achat livtzor. "velassoreka beni atono" — en lach kol ilan serak shebbeeretz yisrael sheeno motzi massoy shete atonot. veshemma tomar en bo yayin, talmud lomar: "kibbes beyayin levusho". veshemma tomar eno adom, talmud lomar: "vedam enav tishte chamer".

Veshemma tomar eno marve — talmud lomar: "suto". veshemma tomar en bo taam — talmud lomar: "chachlili enayim miyyayin". kol chech shettoamo, omer: "li li". veshemma tomar linarim yafe velizkenim eno yafe — talmud lomar: "uleven shinnayim mechalav", al tikre "leven shinnayim" ella "leven shanim".
Peshateh dikra bemay ketiv? ki ata rav dimi, amar: amra keneset yisrael lifne hakkadosh baruch hu: ribbono shel olam, remoz [li] beenaych divsim mechamra, veachvi li shinnaych divsim mechalava.

Mesayyay leh lerabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: tov hammalbin shinnayim lachavero yoter mimmashkehu chalav, shenneemar: "uleven shinnayim mechalav", al tikre "leven shinnayim" ella "libbun shinnayim".
Rav chiyyay bar adda makre dardeke deresh lakish hava. ippaggar telata yome vela ata. ki ata, amar leh: ammay ippaggart?

Amar leh: dalit achat hinniach li abba uvatzarti mimmenna yom rishon shelosh meot eshkolot eshkol legarav, yom sheni batzarti shelosh meot eshkolot shete eshkolot legarav, yom shelishi batzarti mimmenna shelosh meot eshkolot shalosh eshkolot legarav, vehifkarti yoter mechetzyah. amar leh: i lav deippaggart hava avda tefe.
Rame bar yechezkel ikkela livne verak, chazanhu lehanhu izze dekaachlan tute teene vekanatef duvesha mitteene vachalava tayef minnayyhu umiarav bahade hadade. amar: hayeynu: "zavat chalav udevash".

Amar rabbi yaakov ben dostay: millod leono shelosha milin, paam achat kiddamti banneshef vehalachti ad karsullayy bidvash shel teenim. amar resh lakish: ledidi chaze li "zavat chalav udevash" shel tzippori, vehave shittesar milin ashshittesar milin. amar rabba bar bar chana: ledidi chaze li "zavat chalav udevash" shel kol eretz yisrael,

a: Vehavya kemibbe michse ad akra detulebanke, esrin vetarten parse ureka ufuteya shitta parse.

Rabbi chelbo verabbi avvira verabbi yose bar chanina ikkelau lehahu atra. ayyto kammayyhu afarseka dahava keilpas kefar hino. veilpas kefar hino kamma have — chamesh sein. achlu shelish, vehifkiru shelish, venatnu lifne behemtan shelish.
Leshana ikkela rabbi elazar lehatam veayyto lekammeh (nekatu) [nakteh] bideh, veamar: "eretz peri limlecha meraat yoshve vah".

Rabbi yehoshua ben levi ikkela legavla, chazanhu lehanhu kittufe dahavo kayymi ki igle, amar: agalim ben haggefanim? amaru leh: kittufe ninhu. amar: eretz eretz, hachenisi perotayich, lemi at motzia perotayich, legoyim hallalu sheamdu alenu bechattotenu?
Leshana ikkela rabbi chiyyay lehatam, chazanhu dahavo kayymi keizze, amar: izzim ben haggefanim? amaru leh: zil, la taaved lan ki chavrach.

Tanu rabbanan: bevirchoteha shel eretz yisrael — bet sea osa chameshet ribbo korin, bishivatah shel tzoan — bet sea osa shivim korin. detanya, amar rabbi meir: ani raiti bevikat bet shean bet sea osa shivim korin.

Veen lecha meulla bechol aratzot yoter meeretz mitzrayim, shenneemar: "kegan Adonai keeretz mitzrayim". veen lecha meulla bechol eretz mitzrayim yoter mitztzoan — dahavo merabbu ba melachim, dichtiv: "ki hayu vetzoan sarav". veen lecha terashim bechol eretz yisrael yoter mechevron, dahavo kavri bah shaychve.

Vaafillu hachi, chevron mevunna al achat mishshiva betzoan, dichtiv: "vechevron sheva shanim nivneta lifne tzoan mitzrayim", may "nivneta"? ilema nivneta mammash, efshar adam bone bayit livno katan kodem sheyyivne livno gadol? shenneemar: "uvene cham kush umitzrayim ufut uchenaan"!
Ella shemmevunna al achat mishshiva betzoen. vehane mille bitrashim, aval shello bitrashim — chamesh mea.
Vehane mille shello bevirchoteha, aval bevirchoteha, ketiv: "vayyizra yitzchak baaretz hahi vegomer".

Tanya, amar rabbi yose: sea bihuda hayta osa chamesh sein: sea kemach, sea solet, sea subbin, sea muresin, usea kibborya. amar leh hahu tzadduki lerabbi chanina: yae meshabbechitu ba bearachon. bet sea achat hinniach li abba, mimmenna meshach, mimmenna chamar, mimmenna ivur, mimmenna kitniyyot, mimmenna root miknati.

Amar leh hahu bar emoraa levar ara deyisrael: hay [talta] dekayyma aggudda deyardena kamma gadritu minna? amar leh: shittin kore. amar leh: akkatti la ayylitu bah achrevtuha, anan mea veesrim kore hava gazrinan minna. amar leh: ana name mechad gisa kaamena lach.

Amar rav chisda, may dichtiv: "veetten lach eretz chemda nachalat tzevi", lamma eretz yisrael nimshela litzvi? lomar lecha: ma tzevi ze en oro machazik besaro, af eretz yisrael enah machzeket peroteha. davar acher: ma tzevi ze kal mikkol hachayyot, af eretz yisrael kalla mikkol haaratzot levashshel et peroteha.
I ma tzevi ze kal veen besaro shamen — af eretz yisrael kalla levashshel veen peroteha shemenim, talmud lomar: "zavat chalav udevash", shemenim mechalav umetukim middevash.
Rabbi elazar ki hava salek leeretz yisrael, amar: pelati li mechada. ki samchuhu, amar: pelati li mittarte. ki otvuhu besod haibbur, amar: pelati li mittelat,
Shenneemar: "vehayta yadi el hanneviim hachozim shav vegomer". "besod ammi lo yihyu" — ze sod ibbur. "uvichtav bet yisrael lo yikkatevu" — ze semicha. "veel admat yisrael lo yavou" — kemashmao.

Rabbi zera ki hava salek leeretz yisrael la ashkach mabbara lemebar, nekat bemitzra vekaavar. amar leh hahu tzadduki: amma peziza, dekaddemitu pummayychu leudenayychu, akkatti bifzizutayychu kayymitu? amar leh: ducheta demoshe veaharon la zecho la, ana mi yemar dezachena la.
Rabbi abba menashshek kefe deakko. rabbi chanina metakken matkalayya. rabbi amme verabbi assi
b: Kayymi mishshimsha letulla umittulla leshimsha. rabbi chiyyay bar gammada miggandar beafra, shenneemar: "ki ratzu avadecha et avaneha veet afarah yechonenu".

Amar rabbi zera amar rabbi yirmeya bar abba: dor shebben david ba — kategorya betalmide chachamim. ki amrita kammeh dishmuel amar tzeruf achar tzeruf, shenneemar: "veod bah asiriyya veshava vehayta levaer". tane rav yosef: bazoze, uvazoze devazozi.
Amar rav chiyyay bar ashe amar rav: atidin kol ilane serak shebbeeretz yisrael sheyyitanu perot, shenneemar: "ki etz nasa firyo teena vagefen natnu chelam".
Hadaran alach shene dayyayne gezerot uselika la massechet ketubbot

a: Kol kinnuye nedarim — kindarim,
Vacharamim — kacharamim, ushevuot — kishvuot, unezirut — kinzirut.
Haomer lachavero "mudderani mimmach", "mufershani mimmach", "meruchakani mimmach", "sheani ochel lach", "sheani toem lach" — asur.
"Menudde ani lach", rabbi akiva haya chochech baze lehachemir.
b: Gemara "kol kinnuye nedarim kindarim", may shena gabbe nazir dela katane lehu lechullehu, umay shena gabbe nedarim dekatane lechullehu?
Mishshum deneder ushevua ketivi gabbe hadade tane tarten, vechevan detane tarten — tane lechullehu.
Velitne kinnuye shevuot batar nedarim! ayyeyde ditna nedarim demittesar cheftza aleh, tena name charamim, demittesar cheftza aleh. leappoke shevua, dekaasar nafsheh min cheftza.
Petach bechinnuyin "kol kinnuyay nedarim", umefaresh yadot: haomer lachavero "muddar ani mimmach"! vetu: yadot inneshi?!
Ayyri behon, vechassore michassera, vehachi katane: kol kinnuye nedarim kindarim, vidot nedarim kindarim.
Velifrosh kinnuyin beresha!
Hahu desalek minneh, hahu mefaresh beresha. keditnan: bamme madlikin uvamma en madlikin? en madlikin kulei.
Bamme tomnin uvamma en tomnin? en tomnin kulei. bamma ishsha yotza uvamma enah yotza? lo tetze ishsha.
Vechol hecha defatach la mefaresh beresha? vehatnan: yesh nochalin umanchilin, nochalin velo manchilin. veellu nochalin umanchilin.
Yesh muttarot levaalehen vaasurot leyivmehen, muttarot leyivmehen vaasurot levaalehen. veellu muttarot levaalehen vaasurot leyivmehen.
Yesh teunot shemen ulevona, shemen velo levona. veellu teunot shemen ulevona. yesh teunot haggasha veen teunot tenufa, tenufa velo haggasha. veellu teunot haggasha.
Yesh bechor lenachala veen bechor lechohen, bechor lechohen veen bechor lenachala. veezehu bechor lenachala veen bechor lechohen!
Halen, mishshum deavvshu leh, mefaresh hahu defatach beresha.
Veha bamme behema yotza uvamma enah yotza dela avvsha, vekatane: yotze gamal!

a: Ella lav davvka: zimnin mefaresh hahu diftach beresha, zimnin hahu desalek mefaresh beresha. veibbaet ema: yadot ayyeyde deatyayn midderasha, mefaresh lehon beresha.
Veliftach haden beresha! miftach patach bechinnuyin deorayyta beresha, vahadar mefaresh yadot deatyayn leh midderasha.
Hanicha leman deamar kinnuyin leshon nachrim hen. ella leman deamar lashon shebbadu lahen chachamim lihyot noder bo, may ikka lememar?

Mi katane yadot? velav chassore ka mechasserat la? akdem name uteni yadot: kol yedot nedarim kindarim, vechol kinnuye nedarim kindarim, veellu hen yadot: haomer lachavero, veellu hen kinnuyin: kuvnnam, kunnach, kunnas.
Veyadot hecha ketiv? "ish ki yafli lindor neder nazir lehazzir laAdonai", vetanya: "nazir lehazzir" — laasot kinnuye nezirut kinzirut, vidot nezirut kinzirut.

En li ella binzirut, bindarim minnayin? talmud lomar: "ish ki yafli lindor neder nazir lehazzir laAdonai", makkish nezirut lindarim unedarim linzirut; ma nezirut asa bo yedot nezirut kinzirut — af nedarim asa bahem yedot nedarim kindarim.

Uma nedarim over beval yachel". uveval teacher" — af nezirut over beval yachel" uveval teacher". uma nedarim haav mefer nidre vitto uvaal mefer nidre ishto — af nezirut haav mefer nezirut bitto uvaal mefer nezirut ishto.
May shena gabbe nezirut dichtiv "nazir lehazzir", nedarim name ha ketiv "lindor neder", vehekkesha lema li?
I ketav "neder lindor" kedichtav "nazir lehazzir" — kidkaamrat, la tzarich hekkesha. hasheta dichtiv "lindor neder", dibbera tora chilshon bene adam.

Hanicha leman deit leh dibbera tora kilshon bene adam, ella leman delet leh dibbera tora kilshon bene adam, hay "lindor neder" may aved leh? daresh leh: laasot yedot nedarim kindarim, umakkish nezirut lindarim. "nazir lehazzir" daresh leh: melammed
b: Shehannezirut chal al hannezirut.

Uleman deamar dibbera tora kilshon bene adam, venazir lehazzir" daresh laasot yedot nezirut kinzirut, shehannezirut chal al hannezirut mena leh? hanicha i sevira leh keman deamar en nezirut chal al nezirut. ella i sevira leh keman deamar nezirut chal al nezirut, mena leh?
Nema kera "lizzor", may "lehazzir" shamat minna tarte.
Bemareva amri: it tanna demappek leh leyadot min "lindor neder", veit tanna demappek leh, min "kechol hayyotze mippiv yaase".
Amar mar: uma nedarim over beval yachel", uval teacher". bishlama "bal yachel" dindarim mashkachat la, kegon deamar kikkar zo ochal velo achalah — over mishshum "bal yachel devaro".
Ella "bal yachel" dinzirut hechi mashkachat la? kevan deamar "hareni nazir" have leh nazir. achal — kam leh beval yochal". sheta — kam leh beval yishte". amar rava: laavor alav bishnayim.
"Bal teacher" dinzirut hechi mashkachat la? kevan deamar "hareni nazir" have leh nazir. achal — kam leh beval yochal"? beomer "lichsheertze ehe nazir". vei amar "kesheertze" lekka "bal teacher"!

Amar rava: kegon deamar "lo ippater min haolam ad sheehe nazir", demin hahi shata have leh nazir. midde dehave haomer leishto "hare zo gittech shaa achat kodem mitati" — asura leechol bitruma miyyad. alma amrinan kol shata veshata dilma mayet. hacha name, lealtar have nazir. deamrinan: dilma hasheta mayet.

a: Rav acha bar yaakov amar: kegon dindar vehu bevet hakkevarot.

Hanicha leman deamar la chayyla aleh nezirut mealtar. ella leman deamar mealtar chayyla aleh, mi ikka "bal teacher"? veod: haamar mar bar rav ashe: chayyla nezirut aleh mealtar, vechi peligi — leinyan malkot peligi!
Afillu hachi kam leh beval teacher", mishshum deka meachar nezirut detohora. amar rav ashe: hoil vechen, nazir shettimme atzmo bemezid — over mishshum "bal teacher" dinzirut tohora.
Rav acha bereh derav ika amar: over beval teacher" tiglachto.
Vela mibbaya leman deamar tiglachat meakkevet, ella afillu leman deamar tiglachat enah meakkevet, mitzvat gilluach miha la meykayyem.
Mar zutera bereh derav mari amar: over beval teacher" karbenotav.
Umin hacha nafka leh? mehatam nafka leh: "ki darosh yidreshennu" — ellu chattaot vaashamot!
Mahu detema: chiddush hu shechiddesha tora benazir.
May chiddush? illema dela matpes lay lechattat nazir beneder. hare chattat chelev, sheen matpisah beneder, veover beval teacher"!
Ella: may chiddusheh — salka datach amena: hoil veim amar "hareni nazir" afillu min chartzan — have nazir lakkol, ema la layavor aleh mishshum "bal teacher" — ka mashma lan.
Hanicha leman deamar ki nazir min chartzan have nazir lakkol, ella lerabbi shimon deamar en nazir ad sheyyazzir mikkullan — may ikka lememar? veod: hay chiddush lechumera hu!
Ella: may chiddusheh? desalka datach amena: hoil
b: Veim gillach al achat mishsheloshtan — yatza, la layavor aleh beval teacher", ka mashma lan.
Veibbaet ema: may chiddusheh — mishshum delo matpiso beneder. veha deka kashya lach chattat chelev — chattat chelev kaatya lechappara. chattat nazir lemay atya?
Vahare chattat yoledet dela atya lechappara, veavar ala mishshum "bal teacher"! hahi — ka sharya la lemechal bekadashim.
Amar mar: uma nedarim, haav mefer nidre vitto uvaal mefer nidre ishto — af nezirut, haav mefer nezirut bitto uvaal mefer nezirut ishto. lema li hekkesha? tete bema matzinu" minnedarim!
Dilma gabbe nedarim hu demefar, mishshum dela it leh kitztzuta. aval gabbe nezirut deit leh kitztzuta, distam nezirut sheloshim yom, ema la — ka mashma lan.
Haomer lachavero muddar ani vechulei. amar shemuel: bechullan ad sheyyomar, "sheani ochel lach", "sheani toem lach".

Metivi: "muddar ani mimmach" "mufershani mimmach" "meruchakeni mimmach" — hare ze asur. "sheani ochel lach" "sheani toem lach" — hare ze asur! hachi katane: bamme devarim amurim — beomer: "sheani ochel lach" "sheani toem lach".
Vehatanya ippecha: "sheani ochel lach", "sheani toem lach" — asur, "mudderani mimmach" umufershani mimmach" "meruchakani mimmach" — hare ze asur! tane hachi: "uchevar amar mudderani".
I hachi, hayeynu resha! veod: "asur" "asur" lema leh lemitne?
Ella, amar shemuel: tama deamar "sheani ochel lach" "sheani toem lach", hu deasur vachavero muttar.

a: Aval amar "mudderani hemach" lechodeh — shenehen asurin. ki ha deamar rabbi yose berabbi chanina: "mudderani hemach" — shenehen asurin.
Tenan: "hareni alecha cherem" — hammuddar asur, aval maddir la. kegon defaresh: "veat alay la".
"At alay cherem" — hannoder asur, aval muddar la. kegon defaresh: "vaana alach la".
Aval setama may? shenehen asurim. ha middekatane sefa: "hareni alecha veat alay", shenehen asurim, haden hu dishnehem asurin, ha setama — hu asur vachavero muttar!
Ella hachi ittemar derabbi yose berabbi chanina: "muddar ani lach" — shenehem asurin, "mudderani hemach" — hu asur vachavero muttar.
Veha matnitin dekatane "hemach", veokimna lematnitin lishmuel: bechullan ad sheyyomar "sheani toem lach" vesheani ochel lach", hu deasur vachavero muttar, aval bemudderani hemach", shenehem asurin.
Ella meikkara dishmuel hachi ittemar: tama deamar "sheani ochel lach" vesheani toem lach" hu deen hu asur ella baachila. ha "mudderani mimmecha" — asur afillu bahanaa.
I hachi, lema shemuel hachi: veim la amar ella "sheani ochel lach" vesheani toem lach", en asur ella baachila.

Ella hachi ittemar: tama deamar "sheani ochel lach" vesheani toem lach", hu deasur. aval amar "mudderani hemach" — la mashma deamar asur. may tama: "muddar ani mimmach" — la mishtaena bahadach mashma. "mufershani mimmach" — dela avedna immach massa umattan mashma. "meruchakani mimmach" — dela kaemna bearba ammot dilach mashma.
b: Lema kasavar shemuel yadayim sheen mochichot la havvyayn yadayim? in, shemuel mokem la lematnitin kerabbi yehuda, deamar: yadayim sheen mochichot la havvyayn yadayim.
Ditnan, gufo shel get: "hare at mutteret lechol adam". rabbi yehuda omer: "veden deyeheve lichi minnay sefer teruchin veiggeret shibbukin".
Ammay dachek shemuel leokoma lematnitin kerabbi yehuda? lokma kerabbanan af al gav deen yadayim mochichot?
Amar rava: matnitin keshiteh; ammay tane "sheani ochel lach" "sheani toem lach"? litne "sheani ochel" "sheani toem"! shema minna bainan yadayim mochichot.

Ittemar, yadayim sheen mochichot. abbaye amar: havvyayn yadayim, verava amar: la havvyayn yadayim. amar rava: rabbi idi asbera li: amar kera "nazir lehazzir laAdonai", makkish yedot nezirut linzirut. ma nezirut behafelaa — af yedot nezirut behafelaa.

Lema biflugeta derabbi yehuda verabbanan kamippalgi? ditnan: gufo shel get "hare at mutteret lechol adam", rabbi yehuda omer: "veden deyeheve lichi minnay sefer teruchin veget pitturin veiggeret shibbukin". abbaye deamar kerabbanan, verava deamar kerabbi yehuda?
Amar lach abbaye: ana daamari afillu lerabbi yehuda. ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehuda bainan yadayim mochichot ella gabbe get, devainan keritut, velekka. aval bealma — mi shamat leh?
Verava amar: ana daamari afillu lerabbanan. ad kan la kaamri rabbanan dela bainan yadayim mochichot ella gabbe get,

a: Deen adam megaresh et eshet chavero, aval bealma — mi shamat lehu?
Metivi: "hare hu alay", "hare ze [alay]" — asur, mippene shehu yad lekorban. tama deamar "alay" — hu deasur, aval la amar "alay" — la. teyuveta deabbaye!
Amar lach abbaye: tama deamar "alay" — hu deasur. aval amar "hare hu", vela amar "alay", "hare hu dehefker" "hare hu ditzdaka" kaamar. veha "mippene shehu yad lekorban" katane!
Ella ema: tama deamar "alay" — hu asur vachavero muttar, aval amar "hare hu" — shenehen asurin, dedilma "hare hu hekdesh" kaamar.
Metivi: "hare zo chattat" "hare zo asham", af al pi shehu chayyayv chattat veasham — lo amar kelum. "hare zo chattati" "hare zo ashami", im haya mechuyyav — devarav kayyaymin. teyuveta deabbaye!
Amar lach abbaye: ha manni — rabbi yehuda hi. veha abbaye hu deamar: ana daamari — afillu lerabbi yehuda! hadar beh.
Ella lema, rava deamar kerabbi yehuda?
Amar lach rava: ana daamari — afillu lerabbanan. ad kan la kaamri rabbanan dela bainan yadayim mochichot ella gabbe get, deen adam megaresh et eshet chavero. aval bealma bainan yadayim mochichot.
b: Bae rav pappa: yesh yad lekiddushin, o la? hechi dame: ilema deamar la leishsha "hare at mekuddeshet li", veamar lachavertah "veat name" — peshita hayeynu kiddushin atzman! ella kegon deamar la leishsha "hare at mekuddeshet li", veamar la lachavertah "veat". mi amrinan "veat name" amar la lachavertah, vetafsi ba kiddushin lachavertah, o dilma: "veat chazay" amar la lachaverta, vela tafsi bah kiddushin bachaverta.

Umi mibbee leh lerav pappa? veha middaamar leh rav pappa leabbaye: mi savar shemuel yadayim sheen mochichot havyayn yadayim, mikkelal disvira leh lerav pappa deyesh yad lekiddushin! chada miggo may disvira leh lishmuel amar leh leabbaye.

Bae rav pappa: yesh yad lefea, o en yad lefea? hechi dame: ilema deamar "haden ugeya leheve pea, vehaden name" — hahi pea meallayyta hi. ki ka mibbaya leh, kegon deamar "vehaden" vela amar "name", may?
Mikkelal, dechi amar "sade kullah tehve pea", havya pea?
In, vehatanya: minnayin sheim rotze laasot kol sadehu pea — ose, talmud lomar: "peat sadcha".
Mi amrinan: kevan deittakkash lekorbenot; ma korbanot yesh lahem yad, af pea yesh lah yad. o dilma: ki ittakkash — leval teacher" hu deittakkash. vehecha ittakkash? detanya:

a: "Meimmach", ze leket shichcha ufea.

Yesh yad litzdaka, o en yad litzdaka? hechi dame? ilema deamar: "haden zuza litzdaka, vehaden name" — hahu tzedaka atzmah hi! ella kegon deamar "haden" vela amar "name", may? "haden name tzedaka" kaamar, o dilma [may] "vehaden" (name) — lenafkuta bealma kaamar, vedibbura hu dela assekeh.
Mi amrinan: kevan deittakkash lekorbanot, dichtiv: "befich" — zo tzedaka. ma korbanot yesh lahen yad, af tzedaka yesh lah yad. o dilma leval teacher" hu deittakkash?
Yesh yad lehefker, o dilma en yad lehefker? hayeynu tzedaka!

Im timtza lomar kaamar. im timtza lomar yesh yad litzdaka, deen hekkesh lemechetza. hefker mi amrinan hayeynu tzedaka, o dilma shane tzedaka, ditzdaka la chazya ella laaniyyim, aval hefker ben laaniyyim ben laashirim?

Bae ravina: yesh yad levet hakkisse, o la? hechi dame? ilema daamar "haden beta leheve bet hakkisse, vehaden name", hahu bet hakkisse name have! ella kegon deamar "vehaden" vela amar "name". may "haden" deamar — "vehaden name bet hakkisse", o dilma may "vehaden" — letashmisha bealma kaamar.
Mikkelal difshita leh leravina deyesh zimmun levet hakkisse? veha mibbaya leh leravina: hizmino levet hakkisse mahu? hizmino levet hammerchatz mahu? zimmun moil, o en zimmun moil?
Ravina chada miggo chada kamibbaya leh: zimmun moil o en zimmun moil. im timtza lomar yesh zimmun: yesh yad o en yad tibbee leh.
Menudde ani lach vechulei. amar abbaye: mode rabbi akiva leinyan malkot sheeno loke. deim ken, nitne "rabbi akiva machmir".
Amar rav pappa: bindina minnach" — dechulle alma la peligi deasur. "meshammatna minnach" — lechulle alma shere. bemay peligi —
b: Bimnudde ani lach", derabbi akiva savar: lishshana denidduya hu, verabbanan savri: lishshana dimshammatna hu.
Ufeliga derav chisda. dehahu gavra deamar "meshammatna benichseh divreh derav yirmeya bar abba" ata lekammeh derav chisda. amar leh: let dechash la leha derabbi akiva. kasavar: bimshammatna" peligi.
Amar rabbi ila amar rav: niddahu befanav — en mattirin lo ella befanav. niddahu shello befanav — mattirin lo ben befanav ben shello befanav.
Amar rav chanin amar rav: hashshomea hazekarat hashshem mippi chavero tzarich lenaddoto, veim lo niddahu — hu atzmo yehe benidduy. shekkol makom shehazekarat hashshem metzuya, sham aniyyut metzuya.
Vaaniyyut, kemita, shenneemar: "ki metu kol haanashim", vetanya: kol makom shennatnu chachamim enehem", o mita o oni.

Amar rabbi abba: hava kaemna kammeh derav huna, shama lehach itteta deappika hazekarat hashshem levattala, shammeta ushera la lealtar beappa. shema minna telat: shema minna hashshomea hazekarat hashshem mippi chavero tzarich lenaddoto, ushema minna: niddahu befanav, en mattirin lo ella befanav, ushema minna: en ben nidduy lahafara velo kelum.
Amar rav giddel amar rav: talmid chacham menadde leatzmo, umefer leatzmo. peshita? mahu detema: "en chavush mattir atzmo mibbet haasurin", ka mashma lan.
Hechi dame: ki ha demar zutera chasida, ki michayyayv bar be rav shamta — meshammet nafsheh beresha, vahadar meshammet bar be rav. vechi ayel leveteh, share lenafsheh vahadar share leh.
Veamar rav giddel amar rav:

a: Minnayin shennishbain lekayyem et hammitzva, shenneemar: "nishbati vaakayyema lishmor mishpete tzidkecha".
Vahalo musheba veomed mehar sinay hu. ella ha ka mashma lan deshare leh leinish lezaroze nafsheh.

Veamar rav giddel amar rav: haomer "ashkim veeshne perek ze" "eshne massechta zo" — neder gadol nadar lelohe yisrael. vahalo musheba veomed hu, veen shevua chala al shevua! may ka mashma lan, daafillu zaroze bealma — hayeynu derav giddel kammayyta!
Ha ka mashma lan: kevan dei bae patar nafsheh bikriyyat shema shacharit vearvit, mishshum hachi chayel shevua aleh.

Amar rav giddel amar rav: haomer lachavero "nashkim venishne perek ze" — alav lehashekim, shenneemar: "vayyomer elay (ben adam) kum tze el habbika vesham adabber otach vaetze el habbika vehinne sham kevod Adonai omed".
Amar rav yosef: nidduhu bachalom, tzarich asara bene adam lehattir lo, vehu detanu hilcheta, aval matnu vela tanu — la. vei lekka detanu hilcheta — afillu matnu vela tanu.
Vei lekka — lezil velittev apparashat derachim veyahev shelama leve asra, ad demikkali leh asra degamri hilcheta.
Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: yada man shamteh, mahu delishre leh? amar leh: leshammoteh shavveyu shaliach, lemishre leh la shavveyu shaliach.
Amar leh rav acha lerav ashe: shammetuy ushero leh bechelmeh, may? amar leh: keshem shei efshar labbar belo teven,
b: Kach i efshar lachalom belo devarim betelim.
Ravina hava la nidra lidvethu. ata lekammeh derav ashe, amar leh: baal mahu sheyyease shaliach lacharatat ishto? amar leh: i mechannefin — in, i la — la.
Shema minna telat. shema minna: baal naase shaliach lacharatat ishto. ushema minna: la shere lemishre nidra beatra derabbeh. ushema minna: ki mechannefin shappir dame.
Veshamta — afillu beatra derabbeh, veyachid mumeche share shamta.

Amar rabbi shimon bar zevid, amar rabbi yitzchak bar tavla, amar rabbi chiyyay aricha deve rabbi acha, amar rabbi zera, amar rabbi elazar, amar rabbi chanina, amar rabbi meyasha mishshemeh derabbi yehuda bar ilay: may dichtiv "vezarcha lachem yire shemi (shemesh tzedaka vegomer)" ellu bene adam shehen yerein lehotzi shem shamayim levattala. "shemesh tzedaka umarpe". amar abbaye: shema minna chirga deyoma masse.

Ufeliga derabbi shimon ben lakish, deamar: en gehinnam laolam habba, ella hakkadosh baruch hu motzi chamma minnartikah, tzaddikim mitrappein bah ureshaim niddonin bah. shenneemar: "vezarcha lachem yire shemi shemesh vegomer". velo od, ella shemmitaddenin bah, shenneemar: "vitzatem ufishtem keegle marbek".
Veharshaim niddonin bah, shenneemar: "hinne hayyom ba boer kattannur vegomer".

a: Mishna "kenidre reshaim" — nadar benazir uvekorban uvishvua. "kenidre chesherim" — lo amar kelum. "kenidvotam" — nadar benazir uvekorban.
Gemara vedilma hachi kaamar: kenidre reshaim la nadarna? amar shemuel: beomer "kenidre reshaim hareni alay vehemennu", "hareni" — binzirut, "alay" — bekorban, "hemennu" — bishvua.
"Hareni" nezirut. dilma hareni betaanit kaamar? amar shemuel: keshehaya nazir over lefanav.
("Alay" — bekorban) "hemennu" — bishvua. dilma: "hemennu" — deachelna kaamar! amar rava: deamar "hemennu shello ochal".
I hachi may lememra? mahu detema: ha la mappek shevua mippummeh, ka mashma lan haden.
"Kenidre chesherim" — lo amar kelum, "kenidvotam" — nadar vechulei. man tanna deshane leh ben neder lindava? lema la rabbi meir vela rabbi yehuda!
Detanya: "tov asher lo tiddor vegomer", tov mizze umizze — sheeno noder kol ikkar, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: tov mizze umizze noder umeshallem.
Afillu tema rabbi meir,
b: Ki kaamar rabbi meir — beneder, bindava la kaamar. veha katane: "kenidvotam" — nadar benazir uvekorban! teni: nadav benazir uvekorban.
May shena noder dela — dilma ate bah lide takkala? nedava name la — dilma ate bah lide takkala!
Kehillel hazzaken. detanya: amru al hillel hazzaken shello maal adam beolato kol yamav. meviah keshehi chullin laazara, umakdishah, vesomech aleha, veshochatah.
Hanicha nedava dekorbanot. nedava dinzirut may ikka lememar? savar la keshimon hatztzaddik.

Detanya, amar (rabbi) shimon hatztzaddik: miyyamay lo achalti asham nazir tame ella echad. paam achat ba adam echad nazir min haddarom, ureitiv shehu yefe enayim vetov roi ukevutztzotav sedurot lo taltallim. amarti lo: beni, ma raita lehashechit et searcha ze hannae?

Amar li: roe hayiti leabba beiri, halachti lemalloot mayim min hammayayn venistakkalti babbavua shelli, ufachaz alay yitzri uvikkesh letordeni min haolam. amarti lo: rasha! lama atta mitgae beolam sheeno shellecha, bemi shehu atid lihyot rimma vetolea? haavoda, sheagallechacha lashshamayim!
Miyyad amadti uneshaktiv al rosho, amarti lo: beni, kamocha yirbu nozre nezirut beyisrael. alecha hakkatuv omer "ish ki yafli lindor neder nazir lehazzir laAdonai".
Matkef la rabbi mani: may shena asham nazir tame dela achal — deate al chet? kol ashamot name la lechol, deal chet atu!
Amar leh rabbi yona, hayeynu tama: keshehen tohin nozrin. ucheshehen mittammein veravin alehen yeme nezirut, mitchartin bahen, venimtzeu meviin chullin laazara.
I hachi, afillu nazir tahor name! nazir tahor la, deamode amed nafsheh deyachol lindor.
Veibbaet ema:

a: Afillu tema rabbi yehuda, ki amar rabbi yehuda — bindava, beneder la amar.
Vehakatane: "tov mizze umizze noder umekayyem"! teni: "nodev umekayyem".
May shena noder dela, dilma ate bah lide takkala? nedava name, dilma ate bah lide takkala!
Rabbi yehuda letameh, deamar: adam mevi kivsato laazara, umakdisha, vesomech aleha, veshochatah.
Tinach nedava dekorbanot, nedava dinzirut may ikka lememar?

Rabbi yehuda letameh. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: chasidim harishonim hayu mitavvin lehavi korban chattat. lefi sheen hakkadosh baruch hu mevi takkala al yedehem, ma hayu osin? omdim umitnaddevin nezirut lammakom, kede sheyyitchayyev korban chattat lammakom.

Rabbi shimon omer: lo nadru benazir, ella: harotze lehavi ola — mitnaddev umevi, shelamim — mitnaddev umevi, toda vearbaa mine lachmah — mitnaddev umevi. aval binzirut lo hitnaddevu, kede shello yikkaru chotin. shenneemar "vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh".
Amar abbaye: shimon hatztzaddik verabbi shimon verabbi elazar hakkappar kullan shita achat hen, denazir chote have: shimon hatztzaddik verabbi shimon ha daamaran.

Verabbi elazar hakkappar berabbi, detanya, rabbi elazar hakkappar berabbi omer: "vechipper alav measher chata al hannafesh". vechi beezo nefesh chata ze? ella: shetztzier atzmo min hayyayin. vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma ze shello tzier atzmo ella min hayyayin nikra chote, hametzaer atzmo mikkol davar al achat kamma vechamma. mikkan kol hayyoshev betaanit nikra chote.
Vehaden kera benazir tame ketiv! mishshum deshana bechet hu.

Mishna haomer (lachavero) "kuvnnam" "kunnach" "kunnas" — hare ellu kinnuyin lakkorban. "cherek" "cherech" "cheref" — hare ellu kinnuyin lacherem. "nazik" "naziach" "paziach" — hare ellu kinnuyin linzirut. "shevuta" "shekuka", noder bemohi" — hare ellu kinnuyin lashshevua.
Gemara ittemar kinnuyin, rabbi yochanan amar: leshon ummot hen. rabbi shimon ben lakish amar: lashon shebbadu lahem chachamim lihyot noder bo. vechen hu omer: "bachodesh asher bada millibbo".

Vetama may takkinu rabbanan kinnuyin? dela lema "korban". velema "korban"? dilma amar "korban laAdonai". velema "korban laAdonai"? dilma amar "laAdonai" vela amar "korban", veka mappek shem shamayim levattala.
Vetanya, rabbi shimon omer:
b: Minnayin shello yomar adam "laAdonai ola", "laAdonai mincha", "laAdonai toda", "laAdonai shelamim" — talmud lomar: "korban laAdonai".
Vekal vachomer: uma ze shello nitkavvevn ella lehazekir shem shamayim al hakkorban — amra tora "korban laAdonai", levattala — al achat kamma vechamma.
Lema ketannae, bet shammay omrim: kinnuye chinnuyin — asurin. uvet hillel omrim: kinnuye chinnuyin — muttarin.
May lav: man deamar kinnuye chinnuyin asurin, kasavar (kinnuye) chinnuyin leshon ummot hen. uleman deamar muttarim, kasavar lashon shebbadu lahen chachamim?
La, dechulle alma kinnuyin leshon ummot hen, uvet shammay savri: behane name mishtai ummot, uvet hillel savri: behane la mishtai ummot.
Veibbaet ema, bet shammay savri: gazrinan kinnuye chinnuyin mishshum kinnuyin, uvet hillel savri: la gazrinan kinnuye chinnuyin mishshum kinnuyin.

Hechi dame kinnuye chinnuyin dindarim? tane rav yosef: "maknemna" "maknachna" "maknesna". hechi dame kinnuye chinnuyin decherem? tane mafshaa: "charakim" "charachim" "charafim". kinnuye chinnuyin dinzirut? tane rav yosef: "machzekna" "manzachna" "mappichna".
Ibbaya lehu: "mippechazna" may? "mittechazna" may? "mitteazna" may? amar leh ravina lerav ashe: "kinnema" (kaynamea) may? "kuvnnam" kaamar, o dilma "kinneman besem" kaamar?
Amar leh rav acha bereh derav chiyyay lerav ashe: "kinna" may? kinna shel tarnegolin kaamar, o dilma lashon dekuvnnam? tibbee.

Kinnuye chinnuyin dishvua hechi dame? "shevuel" "shevutiel" "shekukael". shevuel? shevuel ben gershom mashma! ella: "shevuvael" "shevutiel" "shekukael" mahu? amar shemuel: amar "ashshivta" — lo amar kelum, "ashkika" — lo amar kelum, "karinsa" — lo amar kelum.
"Nadar bemohi hare ellu chinnuyin". tanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: haomer "bemohi" — lo amar kelum, "bemomata daamar mohi" — hare ellu kinnuyin lashshevua.
Mishna haomer "lachullin sheochal lach", "la kashar" vela deche", "tahor" vetame", "notar" ufiggul" — asur.

Keimmera, kedirim, kaetzim, kaishshim, kammizbeach, kahechol, kirushalayim. nadar beechad mikkol meshammeshe hammizbeach, af al pi shello hizkir korban — hare ze nadar bekorban. rabbi yehuda omer: haomer "yerushalayim" — lo amar kelum.

a: Gemara savruha: may "lachullin" — la lechullin leheve, ella korban.
Manni matnitin? i rabbi meir — let leh mikkelal lav atta shomea hen. ditnan, rabbi meir omer: kol tenay sheeno kitnay bene gad uvene reuven — eno tenay.
Ella rabbi yehuda hi. ema sefa, rabbi yehuda omer: haomer "yerushalayim" — lo amar kelum. middesefa rabbi yehuda — resha lav rabbi yehuda hi!
Kulle rabbi yehuda hi, vehachi katane: sherabbi yehuda omer: haomer "yerushalayim" — lo amar kelum.
Vechi amar "kirushalayim", lerabbi yehuda mi mittesar? vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: haomer "kirushalayim" — lo amar kelum, ad sheyyiddor bedavar hakkarev birushalayim!
Kulla rabbi yehuda hi, utere tannae allibba derabbi yehuda.
b: Tanya: "chullin" "hachullin" "kechullin", ben "sheochal lach" uven "shello ochal lach", — muttar. "lachullin sheochal lach" — asur. "lachullin lo ochal lach" — muttar.
Resha manni — rabbi meir hi, delet leh mikkelal lav atta shomea hen.
Ema sefa: "lachullin lo ochal lach" — muttar. vehatnan: "lakkorban lo ochal lach" — rabbi meir oser. vekashya lan: ha let leh mikkelal lav atta shomea hen?
Veamar rabbi abba, naasa keomer: lekorban yehe, lefichach lo ochal lach. hacha name hachi kaamar leh: la chullin leheve, lefichach lo ochal lach!
Hay tanna savar la kerabbi meir bachada ufelig aleh bachada? savar la kevateh bachada — delet leh mikkelal lav atta shomea hen, ufelig aleh bachada — bekorban.
Rav ashe amar: ha deamar "lachullin", veha deamar "la lechullin", demashma: la leheve chullin ella kekorban.
"Tahor" vetame", "notar" ufiggul" — asur. bae rame bar chama: "hare alay kivsar zivche shelamim leachar zerikat damim", mahu?
I dekaamar behaden lishshana — behettera ka matpes! ella: kegon demachet besar zivche shelamim, umachet dehettera gabbeh, veamar: "ze kaze", may: beikkaro ka matpes, o behettera ka matpes?
Amar rava, ta shema: notar ufiggul.

a: Veha notar ufiggul leachar zerikat damim hu.
Amar leh rav huna bereh derav natan: benotar shel ola. amar leh: im ken, litne bivsar ola!
La mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya "besar ola" deasur, deha bekorban ka matpes, notar ufiggul deola itztericha,
Salka datach amena keissur notar, keissur piggul, vehave leh kematpes bedavar haasur, vela mittesar, ka mashma lan.

Metivi: ezehu issar haamur betora? amar: "hareni shello ochal basar veshello eshte yayin kayyom shemmet bo aviv", "kayyom shemmet bo rabbo", "kayyom shenneherag bo gedalya ben achikam", "kayyom sheraiti yerushalayim bechurebanah", veamar shemuel: vehu shennadur beoto hayyom.
Hechi dame? lav kegon dekae bechad beshabba demit beh avu, veaf al gav deikka tuva chad beshabba dehettera, vekatane asur. shema minna beikkar hu matpes.
Dishmuel, hachi ittemar, amar shemuel: vehu shennadur uva meoto hayyom veelach.
Amar ravina, ta shema: "kechallat aharon", "vechitrumato" — muttar. ha "kitrumat lachme toda" — asur.
b: Veha terumat lachme toda — leachar zerikat damim hi.
Ema: "kitrumat hallishka" — asur.
Aval terumat lachme toda may — muttar? litne lachme toda, vechol shekken terumato! ha ka mashma lan terumat lachme toda — terumato hi.
Vei baet ema: terumat lachme toda name kodem zerikat damim hu. kegon deafreshinhu belesha.
Vechi ha deamar rav tovi bar kisna amar shemuel: lachme toda sheafaan bearba challot — yatza. vehachtiv arbaim! lemitzva.

Veha bae lemishkal teruma! vechi tema deshakel chada rifta al kulla — vehatnan: echad mikkol korban. shello yittol mikkorban al chavero! vechi tema deshakel perusa mikkol chad vechad, vehatnan: "echad", shello yittol perusa!
Ella deafreshinhu belesha. deshakel chada mechametz, vachada min challot, vachada min rekikim, vachada min revucha.
Lema ketannae: "hare alay kivchor", rabbi yaakov oser, verabbi yehuda mattir.
Hechi dame? i nema lifne zerikat damim, may tama deman deshare. vei leachar zerikat damim, may tama deman deasar? ella lav,

a: Demachet besar bechor umachet basar dehaych gabbeh, veamar "ze kaze". vetannae hi.
La, dechulle alma lifne zerikat damim, umay tama deman deshare — amar kera: "ki yiddor", ad sheyyiddor bedavar hannadur, leappoke bechor, dedavar haasur hu.
Uman deasar, amar kera: "laAdonai", lerabbot davar haasur.
Uman deshare, "laAdonai" may aved leh? mibbee leh lematpis bechattat veasham.
Uma raita lerabbot chattat veasham ulehotzi et habbechor? merabbe ani chattat veasham shehu matpis beneder, umotzi ani et habbechor shehu kadosh mimmee immo.
Uman deasar, bechor name matpiso beneder hu. detanya, mishshum rabbi amru: minnayin lenolad bechor betoch beto, shemmitzva lehakedisho, shenneemar: "hazzachar takdish".
Uman deshare, ki la makdesh leh mi la mikkaddesh?
"Keimmera", "kaddirim".

Tana: "immera", "leimmera", "keimmera", "dirim", "laddirim" "kaddirim", "etzim", "laetzim", "kaetzim", "ishshim", "laishshim", "kaishshim", "mizbeach", "lammizbeach", "kammizbeach", "hechol", "lahechol", "kahechol", "yerushalayim", "lirushalayim", "kirushalayim", kullan: "sheochal lach" — asur. "lo ochal lach" — muttar.
Man shaminan leh dela shane leh "immera" "leimmera" "keimmera" — rabbi meir hi.
Ema sefa: vechullan "lo ochal lach" — muttar. vehatnan: "lakkarban lo ochal lach" — rabbi meir oser, veamar rabbi abba: naasa keomer "lekarban yehe, lefichach lo ochal lach".
La kashya: ha deamar "la leimmera", ha deamar "leimmera".

Mishna haomer "korban", "ola", "mincha", "chattat", "toda", "shelamim", "sheani ochel lach" — asur. rabbi yehuda mattir. "hakkorban", "kakkorban", "korban sheochal lach" — asur. "lakkorban lo ochal lach" — rabbi meir oser.
Gemara katane "korban", "hakkorban", "kakkorban sheochal lach" — asur. setama tena kerabbi meir, dela shane leh ben "immera" "leimmera".

[I rabbi meir — ha] dekatane: "hakkorban sheochal lach" — asur, vehatanya: modim chachamim lerabbi yehuda beomer "ha korban", veha ola" veha mincha" veha chattat sheochal lach" — shemmuttar? shello nadar ze ella bechayye korban!
b: La kashya: ha deamar "ha korban", veha deamar "hakkorban". may tama? chayye korban kaamar.
Katane: "lakkorban lo ochal lach", rabbi meir oser. veha let leh lerabbi meir mikkelal lav atta shomea hen! amar rabbi abba: naasa keomer: lekorban yehe, lefichach lo ochal lach.
Mishna haomer lachavero "kuvnnam pi medabber immach", "yadi osa immach", "ragli mehallechet immach" — asur.

Gemara ureminhu: chomer bashshevuot mibbannedarim uvannedarim mibbashshevuot. chomer bannedarim, shehannedarim chalim al hammitzva kevarshut, ma sheen ken bashshevuot. vechomer bashshevuot, shehashshevuot chalot al davar sheyyesh bo mammash vesheen bo mammash, ma sheen ken bannedarim.
Amar rav yehuda: beomer "yeaser pi ledibburi", "yaday lemaasehem", "raglay lehilluchan". dayka name, dekatane "pi medabber immach", vela katane "sheani medabber immach".
Haderan alach kol kinnuye
Mishna veellu muttarin: "chullin sheochal lach", "kivsar chazir", "kaavoda zara", "keorot levuvin", "kinvelot uterefot", "kishkatzim uremasim", "kechallat aharon vechitrumato" — muttar.
Haomer leishto "hare at alay keimma" — potchin lo petach mimmakom acher. shello yakel rosho lechach.
Gemara tama deamar "chullin sheochal lach" ha amar "lachullin sheochal lach", mashma: la lechullin leheve ella korban.
Manni matnitin? i rabbi meir — ha let leh mikkelal

a: Lav atta shomea hen! veella rabbi yehuda, hayeynu resha!
Ayyeyde dekatane "kivsar chazir", "kaavoda zara", lehachi katane "chullin".
Ravina amar: hachi katane, veellu muttarin: "kechullin", "kivsar chazir", "kaavoda zara". vei la tena chullin, hava amena bae sheela.

Umi ikka leassoke al data hachi? ha middekatane sefa: haomer leishto "hare at alay keimma" — potchin lo petach mimmakom acher, mikkelal deresha la baaya sheela! ella mechavvavrta, chullin mimmela nasva.
Menahane mille? amar kera: "ish ki yiddor neder laAdonai" — ad sheyyiddor bedavar hannadur.
I hachi, afillu bedavar haasur name, deha ketiv "lesor issar al nafsho"! "lesor issar" mibbee leh lechidtanya: ezehu issar haamur battora kulei.
Haomer leishto hare at keimma kulei. ureminhu: hare at alay kivsar imma, kivsar achoti, keorla, uchechile hakkerem — lo amar kelum!
Amar abbaye: lo amar kelum middeorayyta, vetzarich sheela midderabbanan. rava amar: ha betalmide chachamim, ha beam haaretz.
Vehatanya: hannoder battora — lo amar kelum. veamar rabbi yochanan: vetzarich sheela lechacham. veamar rav nachman: vetalmid chacham eno tzarich sheela.
b: Tanya: hannoder battora — lo amar kelum. bema shekkatuv bah — devarav kayyaymin. bah uvema shekkatuv bah — devarav kayyaymin.
Katane "bema shekkatuv bah" — devarav kayyaymin, "bah uvema shekkatuv bah" — tzerich lememar?
Amar rav nachman, la kashya: ha — demachata orayyta aara, ha — denaket la bideh. machata al ara — dateh aggevile. naket la bideh — dateh al haazkarot shebbah.
Veibbaet ema: demachata al ara. veha ka mashma lan, deaf al gav demachata al ara — kevan deamar "bema shekkatuv bah" mahane. vezo veen tzarich lomar zo katane.
Vei baet ema: kullah metziata name denaket leh bideh. veha ka mashma lan: kevan denaket leh bideh, af al gav dela amar ella "bah" — keman deamar "bema shekkatuv bah" dame.
Mishna "kuvnnam sheani yashen", "sheani medabber", "sheani mehallech", haomer leishsha "kuvnnam sheani meshammeshech" — hare ze belo yachel devaro".

Gemara ittemar: "kuvnnam enay beshena hayyom im ishan lemachar", amar rav yehuda amar rav: al yishan hayyom, shemma yishan lemachar. verav nachman amar: yishan hayyom, vela chayyshinan shemma yishan lemachar. umode rav yehuda beomer "kuvnnam enay beshena lemachar im ishan hayyom", sheyyishan hayyom.

a: Ki la mizdehayr — bitnaa, aval beissura — mizdehar.

Tenan: kuvnnam sheani yashen, sheani mehallech, sheani medabber vechulei. hechi dame? illema kidkatane, "sheani yashen" mi have nidra? vehatnan: chomer bashshevuot, shehashshevuot chalot al davar sheyyesh bo mammash veal davar sheen bo mammash, ma sheen ken bannedarim. veshena davar sheen bo mammash hu! ella deamar: "kuvnnam enay beshena".
Vei dela yahev shiura, mi shavkinan leh ad deavar issur "bal yachel"? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: "shevua shello ishan shelosha yamim" — malkin oto veyashen lealtar!
Ella daamar "kuvnnam enay beshena lemachar im ishan hayyom". ha amrat kol beissureh, mizdehar?
Ella peshita deamar "kuvnnam enay beshena hayyom im ishan lemachar". vei la nayem hayyom, ki nayem lemachar may "bal yachel devaro" ikka? ella lav bidnayem. alma iteh denayem. uteyuveta derav yehuda!
Ki katane, dei nayem.
Ravina amar: leolam kidkatane umay "bal yachel" — midderabbanan.
Umi ikka "bal yachel" midderabbanan? in, vehatanya: devarim hammuttarin vaacherim nahagu bahen issur — i atta rashshay lehattiran bifnehem, shenneemar: "lo yachel devaro".
Tenan: "sheat nehenet li ad happesach im telchi levet avich ad hechag", halcha lifne happesach — asura bahanaato ad happesach.
Halcha lifne happesach — asura, lo halcha — la!
Amar rabbi abba: halcha lifne happesach — asura, veloka. lo halcha — asura bealma.
Ema sefa: achar happesach beval yachel devaro". vei dela ithani lifne happesach, mi ikka "bal yachel"? ella peshita deithani. alma mithane,
b: Uteyuveta derav yehuda!
Ki katane, dei ithani hare ze beval yachel devaro".
Tenan: "sheat nehenet li ad hechag im telchi levet avich ad happesach", halcha lifne happesach — asura bahanaato ad hechag, umutteret lelech achar happesach.
Halcha — asura, lo halcha — la.
Amar rava: hu haddin daafillu lo halcha asura. halcha — asura veloka, lo halcha — asura bealma.
Metivi: "kikkar zo alay hayyom im elech lemakom peloni lemachar", achal — hare ze beval yelech"!
Mi katane "ochel"? "achal" katane, dechi achal hare ze beval yelech".
Halach — hare ze beval yachel" devaro. mehallech — la. vekashya lerav yehuda!
Amar lach rav yehuda: hu haddin delitne "mehallech". ayyeyde dekatane resha "achal", dela mitne leh "ochel" — tane sefa "halach".
Haomer leishsha "kuvnnam sheani meshammeshech", hare ze beval yachel devaro". veha mishtabad lah middeorayyta, dichtiv: "sheerah kesutah veonatah lo yigra"!
Beomer "hanaat tashmishech alay", veha la ka nicha leh betashmish.
Deamar rav kahana: "tashmishi alecha" — kofin otah umeshammashto, deshabode meshuebedet leh. "hanaat tashmishcha alay" — asur, sheen maachilin lo leadam davar haasur lo.
Mishna shevua sheeni yashen, sheeni medabber, sheeni mehallech — asur. korban lo ochal lach, ha korban sheochal lach, lo korban lo ochal lach — muttar.
